item.title: India’s Gulf migration model faces a new test - The Migration Story
item.description: The migrant workforce in the Gulf has weathered many geopolitical tensions and economic downturns in the past. But the ongoing West Asia conflict could have a far greater impact with the uncertainties already beginning to reshape economies and labour markets.

item.title: ‘Each brick carries the mark of a worker’s hand, but once it becomes part of a wall or a building that trace disappears’ - The Migration Story
item.description: Through his Kochi-Muziris Biennale installation, Only the Earth Knows Their Labour, artist Birender Kumar Yadav reflects on seasonal migration, precarious labour and the lives of brick kiln workers, evoking their presence through traces rather than bodies.

item.title: Narratives for impact: Storytelling skills for development professionals - The Migration Story
item.description: Many organisations working in the development sector are producing important work on the ground, but these efforts remain insufficiently communicated beyond reports and documentation

item.title: ‘We can’t blame anyone who migrates’: North Karnataka’s khana weavers speak of its glorious past and difficult present - The Migration Story
item.description: Despite recent efforts to revive khana, a fabric woven for saree blouses only in Guledggudda town, weavers tell a long history of migration to cities in search of better-paying work

item.title: In Telangana's withering grape farms, workers toil to sustain the harvest - The Migration Story
item.description: On Hyderabad's. outskirts, migrant workers from Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha and West Bengal face an uncertain future as rapid urbanisation and new industries eat into farms, shrinking their size and jobs

item.title: The anatomy of a protest: Why workers across refineries in India are striking work? - The Migration Story
item.description: From Panipat to Surat and Barauni, recent protests by workers constructing crucial petroleum oil refineries across India flag stagnant wages and precarious contracts

item.title: The shadow of conflict stretches from Manipur to Munirka - The Migration Story
item.description: Women from strife-torn Manipur migrated to New Delhi’s Munirka, a hub for people from the North-East, but found insecure jobs, hardship and discrimination

item.title: Of love, longing and loneliness in an empty Assam village - The Migration Story
item.description: The Deka family lives all alone in their ancestral home in one of Assam’s most flood-prone regions, unable to afford land or migrate elsewhere

item.title: Working out the economics behind the labour codes - The Migration Story
item.description: Development economist Dr Santosh Mehrotra unpacks the implications of India's new codes and the governance questions that arise from the attempts to reform labour laws

item.title: Unions navigate a changing plantation workforce in Kerala - The Migration Story
item.description: As Idukki’s tea plantations witness a demographic shift from Tamil migrants to workers from states like Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal, trade unions act as bridgemakers through mediation, negotiation and conciliation
